post.description:
Two-step model: `store` reserves the slot (PENDING_PAYMENT). This flips the
held booking to IN_PROGRESS ("paid") so it counts toward revenue and stops the
hold-expiry job from releasing its slot. Idempotent and slot-neutral — the
seats were already deducted at booking time.
post.summary: Confirm a held partner booking after the partner has collected payment on their side

get.description:
Advanced filters mirror the public tour search while preserving partner
whitelist scoping. Query params: search/q (tour code, tour name, route
location name/code, tour type keyword), going_to (city code), travel_style
(single id), list_travel_styles (underscore-separated ids), category
(underscore-separated ids), sub_type/list_sub_types (underscore-separated
ids), minPrice/maxPrice (interpreted in X-Currency), budget, sortBy
(shortest_duration, lowest, highest, newest), page, per_page.
get.summary: List/search all active tours whitelisted for the authenticated partner

get.description:
Step 1 of the booking flow: returns the tour's active calendar windows so the
partner site can build a date picker. The buyer picks a day, then validates
it with `calendar-by-date`. Each item describes one bookable date range, its
capacity and its prices:
- `start_date` / `end_date` — the range the tour departs in.
- `max_slots_per_day` — daily seat capacity (null = unlimited).
- `day_slots[]` — per departure date, the `booked_slots` and `remaining_slots`
  (use this to grey out full days in the picker).
- `prices[]` — per pax range, the adult / child / infant prices.

All prices are in the `X-Currency` header currency (default USD). This
endpoint takes no query parameters.
get.summary: List active departure calendars for a whitelisted tour

get.description:
Step 2 of the booking flow: after the buyer picks a day from `calendars`,
call this to confirm the date is bookable for the requested `pax` and to get
the exact price. The `pax` count selects the matching price range, and the
adult / child / infant prices returned belong to that range.

Three possible outcomes:
- Bookable — `is_available = true`, plus `tour_price_group_id`, `price`
  (adult/child/infant for the matched range), `all_prices` (every pax range),
  `matched_range`, and `remaining_slots`. Pass `tour_price_group_id` and the
  date on to `quote` / booking.
- Sold out — `is_available = false` with `remaining_slots` (fewer seats left
  than `pax`); no price is returned.
- No active calendar for the date, or the day is blocked — HTTP 404.

All prices are in the `X-Currency` header currency (default USD).
get.summary: Check availability and price for one departure date

sub_total_amounts.description:
Additive fields (§11.6/§14.5) — sub-price UI reads these instead of
recomputing from a live exchange rate (fixes the frozen-order
sub-price drift bug, currency-cast-analysis.md §11.3).

group_price.description:
group_price is currently always 0 at booking time
(OrderService::createOrder) and isn't summed into sub_total
anywhere — safe to convert independently.

discount_price.description:
Always equal to the order-level discount (OrderService::createOrder
writes the same value to both) — reuse the already-derived figure
instead of converting it a second time.

refund_total.description: Refund amounts are admin-entered in USD canonical — convert by version.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
